body:
The vertical landed at e661470 and it is ONE SENTENCE. Literally:

  NarrativeCompilerVerticalSuite.scala:30
    private val selected = atlas.sentences(3)

That was the right scope to land -- it proved the arrow exists, which is what turned SEVERED
into NARROW. Widening it is what turns NARROW into USABLE, and it is now the critical path.

WHY IT IS URGENT RATHER THAN NEXT. bd-01M17JFDHKHPD6N6JWA7NCMM4A may deliver real human serial
reproductions of War of the Ghosts -- 80 participants, 16 chains, five generations. Our source
side for WoG is already built and validated. THE ONLY THING BETWEEN THOSE TWO FACTS IS A VERTICAL
THAT RUNS ON MORE THAN ONE SENTENCE. If the recalls arrive and the compiler still handles
sentence 3 in isolation, we will have real data and no way to put it through the pipeline.

THE TASK, deliberately shaped like the owner-directed spike that worked: RUN IT ON THE FULL WOG
TEXT AND REPORT THE FIRST WALL. Not "make it work" -- walk it, and when it stops, the point at
which it stopped and the reason IS the deliverable.

  1. Extend the vertical from atlas.sentences(3) to the whole source.
  2. Report where it breaks, raw. Do not tidy the friction into recommendations.
  3. FAILURE IS A VALID OUTCOME and is worth more than a number obtained by heroics. If
     multi-sentence input hits the DiscourseTrajectory gap that new-engineer deliberately built
     to BLOCK PROMOTION, that is not a bug -- it is the compiler refusing to invent a trajectory
     it cannot derive, and the finding is what it would take to derive one honestly.

EXPECT THAT WALL SPECIFICALLY. The landed compiler records a gap, leaves the trajectory empty and
blocks promotion on multi-situation input. So a full-text run probably does not reach
RecallSignature at all on the first attempt. Report exactly where and why rather than reaching
for the derive path -- that path is absence-erasing and is closed on purpose.

WHAT THIS IS NOT: not an ask to widen the SCIENTIFIC claim. The vertical proves mechanical
reachability. A full-text run proves mechanical reachability over a full text. Neither is an
answered research question, and whoever takes this should keep new-engineer's phrasing discipline
-- it survived three review rounds precisely because it was sized honestly.

WHO: someone NOT holding a sweep or blend bead. Fresh eyes are useful here for the same reason
they were in the original spike -- the friction an author routes around without noticing is the
friction a researcher will hit and not route around.

Unassigned. Volunteer on coordination.
